_about: The app's theme, recorded before the first screen (references/project-setup.md, section 3). App.pa.yaml defines one token per colour and font below, once; screens reference the tokens and never a literal (check-canvas-format.mjs enforces it). Change a value here and in App.pa.yaml together.
status: interim | agreed - and what is still pending

intake.palette: the organisation's brand colours, and any colours it must not use
intake.fonts: brand font, or the platform default
intake.logo: file, where it lives, owner, licence
intake.imagery: photography or illustration style, sources, licence
intake.iconography: icon set; icons or marks that carry meaning, and any to avoid
intake.symbolism: emblems, programme marks, colours with meaning (safety, status)
intake.landingPage: what each role must see first on the home screen, in order
intake.tone: e.g. plain, instructional; words to use or avoid
intake.contrast: e.g. WCAG AA 4.5:1 for body text; minimum text size
intake.mode: light | dark | both; design surface e.g. 1366x768

typography.fntBody: Font.'Segoe UI' or the brand font
